domains.owner: Chengyue-Lu; cross-owner review for CI authority
unknowns: Routing distinguishes neither planner selection authority from coverage authority nor semantic changes from metadata-only changes; the accepted exact-base policy and external witness retain that decision.
Git object identity, merge target, mode changes, environment, runner and Python versions are required inputs outside path membership.
Unknown executable inputs and modified diagnostics cannot authorize a smaller accepted plan.

domains.owner: Chengyue-Lu; Huang Yi reviews adapter and execution crossings
unknowns: This ownership domain contains distinct Protocol, Capability, Context, M4 Artifact, Research State and Trace subcontracts; routing never requires all of them by itself.
Parser, hashing, package initialization and registry changes may have real consumers in every other domain.
Skill directories contain runtime inputs and potentially executable scripts; adding a Skill is not a documentation-only exclusion proof.
Trace archive instances and Trace implementation have different invocation boundaries; a same-name archive file does not bind a business consumer.

domains.owner: Chengyue-Lu; Huang Yi reviews Provider and execution document semantics
unknowns: SchemaCatalog reads every member of the requested versioned schema directory; its default constructor also validates RuntimeResources inventory.
load_and_validate caller inputs, indirect references, root membership and fixture lifecycle remain invocation-specific obligations.
Additions, deletions, renames, symlinks, explicit roots and alternate callers require closure; a changed data instance is not a changed reader implementation.
Registry and catalog routing can overlap other domains because whole-inventory validation is currently real behavior.

domains.owner: Huang Yi (let778750-cpu); Chengyue-Lu reviews core semantic crossings
unknowns: The accepted provider-wire, provider-conformance, provider-session and provider-cli groups remain separate contracts with existing downstream obligations.
Provider SDK, network, credential, model slot and environment boundaries cannot be inferred from repository paths.
Local synthetic Provider tests do not establish live conformance or permit dropping actual session and CLI consumers.

domains.owner: Chengyue-Lu; Huang Yi reviews Provider ports and execution facts
unknowns: Manifest qualification, protocol, comparability, harness plan/preflight and harness execution/replay are separate subcontracts.
Harness execution uses real local execution ports and shares baseline/Skill fixtures; provider and execution crossings need exact invocation evidence.
Fixture inheritance, shared mutable seeds and imported test helpers are not closed by matching a helper filename.
Structural CI results remain separate from scientific efficacy and human acceptance.

domains.owner: Huang Yi (let778750-cpu); Chengyue-Lu owns View and Skill supply semantics
unknowns: Bundle/View, host, generic closeout, Skill extension, baseline transport and cold file replay require independent input and lifecycle contracts.
Shared initializers, Trace construction, helper inheritance and subprocesses retain their actual cross-domain obligations.
Fresh replay, authority checks, before-use and after-return invalidation are distinct failure boundaries; one successful execution does not replace them.

domains.owner: Chengyue-Lu; Huang Yi reviews runtime and installation integration
unknowns: CLI command families share one source file and broad imports; the Git HEAD observation record closes neither other commands nor alternate reads.
RuntimeResources and public source selection consume declared inventories and package documentation; release/installation membership is not ordinary documentation membership.
Generated README output names alone do not establish input consumption; constructor resources and public build closure remain real inputs.
Branch, tag, protected source-CI and release authority are independent governance requirements, not consequences of a passing diagnostic.

domains.owner: Chengyue-Lu; each workstream retains its named accountable owner
unknowns: A docs or work path only routes review; it does not prove absence of runtime reads, scripts, schema references or catalog inclusion.
Documentation link checking reads all Markdown and observes existence of non-Markdown targets, including deleted and renamed targets.
Public source/build closure consumes some documentation and package inputs; archive hash, reference and root membership require their own actual validator invocation.
No accepted invocation-specific archive exclusion witness is declared; the first docs/archive pilot remains unactivated.
